I need to decide on an auction bid for Kentucky Avenue.

The current high bid is $51. I need to bid at least $52. I am in jail with only $1179 cash. Kentucky would not complete a color group for me. Its mortgage value is $110.

p4 has $74 in cash. I will bid $52 to keep raising until they reach that limit, then take the property at $75. I am weighing whether that value is worth the $220 purchase price.

I cannot easily acquire the red monopoly. The property would be worth $110 if mortgaged immediately, yielding a profit over the $75 bid. Denying p4 the space is strategic because they lack cash and could mortgage it later for emergency funds.

If p4 wins the auction, they would mortgage Kentucky immediately for $110. They would net $36 cash and a mortgaged property. This makes the high bid strategy less appealing.

Any winning bid under $110 gives the winner an immediate cash profit of $110 minus the bid amount. I should therefore take the property at $75, since p4 cannot afford to outbid me.
